name: gitask-cli
description: Git-backed Kanban for a Tasks/ folder: board, move, assign, sub-tasks, reports, GitHub sync and a local browser UI.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter gitask-ui run build && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --loader:.js=text --loader:.css=text --loader:.svg=text --loader:.png=dataurl --outfile=dist/gitask.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && chmod +x dist/gitask.js
